description.zh: 要查询的外发投递配置名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个外发投递配置。
description.en: The name of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh:
要查询的外发投递配置类型。取值为：

- **syslog**：表示外发到syslog服务。
- **kafka**：表示外发到kafka服务。
description.en:
The type of the log delivery configuration that you want to query. Valid values:

- **syslog**: Log delivery to a syslog server.

- **kafka**: Log delivery to a Kafka cluster.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-50，默认值为20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的**NextToken**参数值。首页查询无需传入。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the value of **NextToken** returned in the previous call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the WAF instance belongs.

title.zh: 查询所有混合云日志外发投递配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-delivery-configs --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --delivery-name-like test --delivery-type kafka --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --next-token AAAAAINZ+8pH1oQnusEu1tGAc8is --max-results 20 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeLogDeliveryConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --NextToken 'AAAAAINZ+8pH1oQnusEu1tGAc8is' --InstanceId 'waf-cn-zz11sr50000' --DeliveryNameLike test --MaxResults 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DeliveryType kafka
